newsitem.title: GREECE: Hellenic Invest H1 profit jumps 175 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hellenic Invest H1 profit jumps 175 pct.

text.p: Closed-end investment trust Hellenic Invest said its first half earnings rose 175 percent to 6,086 million drachmas from 2,213 million in the year-ago period.

The rise came after a 364 percent increase in gains from portfolio transactions to 5.63 billion drachmas over the first half of 1997 which greatly outweighed a 29 percent drop in portfolio income to 926 million drachmas.
Quoted at 2,375 drachmas on June 30, 1997, the fund's shares traded at a 4.0 percent discount to their net asset value (NAV) of 2,473 drachmas.
On the same date, Hellenic Investments had unrealised portfolio gains of 3,271 million drachmas, reversing its year-earlier picture when it had an unrealised loss of 712 million drachmas.
The fund started the year with unrealised gains of 273 million drachmas in its portfolio.
Hellenic Investments successfully completed a 6.4 billion drachma rights issue of three new shares per 10 outstanding at 1,900 drachmas each on June 23.
